description: REPAIR IRPAnalyzer is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Brad Wham, University of Nevada Reno (unr.edu). IRPAnalyzer is a user-friendly application that was developed as part of the REPAIR project, which was funded by the Advanced Research Projects Agency-Energy (ARPA-E) within Unites States Department of Energy. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (TXT, EXE, ZIP). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gxqj-3s60. Keywords: Internal replacement pipe (IRP) system, Legacy pipelines, Pipe rehabilitation, Trenchless repair, Lateral deformation, Axial deformation. Published 2025-12-09. Facility named: Center for Infrastructure, Energy, and Space Testing, Centre for Future Materials. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
